name: Cheerleader: reverse side of life
source:
Cheerleading not only welcomes people to the stadium and participates in loud parties with players.

There is also a second side. it is a side of mental state, domestic problems and love.

In this novella you will learn about the problems of the protagonist, about life in the hostel and her beautiful roommate.

[From Steam (removed)]
translation:
啦啦队不仅欢迎人们来到体育场，还与球员一起参加喧闹的派对。

还有第二面。这是精神状态、家庭问题和爱情的一面。

在这部中篇小说中，你将了解主角的问题、宿舍的生活以及她美丽的室友。

[来自Steam（已删除）]
